'''Caren Endelle''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Red Ajah]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Caren Endelle}} She was part of [[Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan]]'s secret expedition to kidnap [[Rand al'Thor]] in [[Cairhien]].

==Strength and Abilities==
Caren is is [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|very weak]] for an Aes Sedai, with a strength in the One Power of {{opsl|43}}. Along with [[Bennae Nalsad]] and [[Nisain a'Cowel]], she is the joint fourth weakest Aes Sedai about which we have information.

== Activities ==
After kidnapping Rand and escaping capture during the [[Battle of Dumai's Wells]] she flees to [[Dorlan]]. 

=Trivia==
Caren Endelle is described only in "The Wheel of Time Companion", she is never mentioned in the main books of the Wheel of Time.
